module_summary: Sequential shift-and-add multiplier: sign-extended operands latched at reset, a 5-bit counter steps 16 cycles adding the shifted multiplicand into p per multiplier bit, then asserts rdy.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: Product accumulator output, adds shifted multiplicand when multiplier bit set.

anchors.name: ctr
anchors.why: Iteration counter 0-16; selects multiplier bit and terminates operation.

anchors.name: multiplicand
anchors.why: Sign-extended operand b, left-shifted each iteration and added to p.

anchors.name: multiplier
anchors.why: Sign-extended operand a; bit ctr gates accumulation.

anchors.name: rdy
anchors.why: Level done flag set once counter reaches 16.

groups.name: control
groups.description: Iteration counter and ready flag sequencing 16 add-shift steps.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers, shifter and product accumulator.
